messages:
Asha Patel: Hey team — planning to pin galaxy-2b for the public catalog tomorrow 09:30 PT. Who's available to run the smoke checks and take deployment ownership?
Marco Li: I can take deploy owner. Will be online at 09:00 PT to warm things up.
Devon: I'll do the smoke checklist and verify latency/throughput. Leaving a short runbook here so we don't forget: 1) deploy alias -> pin 2) run 1000 reqs perf smoke 3) sanity prompts + eval set 4) rollback if <95% pass or latency >150ms p50.
Priya Rao: Adding QA Sam for regression checks on the prompt set. @QA Sam can you sign off on acceptance criteria?
QA Sam: Yep — I'll run the evals right after smoke. Quick note: the eval harness sometimes times out on long-context prompts; will use trimmed set and send results in thread.
deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-2321 (owner: Marco Li). Scheduled window: 2026-03-19 09:30 PT. Automated canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% unless manual stop.
Asha Patel: Thanks. Marco — for rollback readiness, can you keep the old alias pinned as variant-old until we confirm metrics? Command we'll use: `redwoodctl pin model:galaxy-2b@v2.2 --alias galaxy-stable --keep-backup variant-old`
Marco Li: Yup, I'll keep backup pinned and hold the final 100% step until Devon + QA Sam thumbs up.
Devon: I'll run perf smoke and share a short log snippet. If anything looks off I'll open a rollback flag and ping here.
Priya Rao: Reminder for logs/tracing: enable verbose traces for the first 30 mins of traffic (set header X-Trace: dev). Also enable token-cost debug for the run.
QA Sam: Quick accept criteria: semantic score >=0.86 on regression set, hallucination rate <2%. If either fails, we rollback.
Asha Patel: Cool. Marco — can you also ensure model metadata has the new safety tags and the billing profile updated? small checklist: - safety_tags updated - billing_profile = "compact-2b" - docs PR linked in ticket
Marco Li: Will do. Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5042 (in draft).
Devon: Smoke run command I'm using: ```bash
# run 1k queries against canary
redwoodctl test --model galaxy-2b --variant v2.2 --requests 1000 --concurrency 20 --report smoke.json
```
Devon: Posting quick early numbers as soon as done.
QA Sam: Running eval harness now (truncated prompts). ETA ~25m.
Asha Patel: If everything green, we aim to finish rollout by 10:15 PT. If we hit a blocker, fallback plan is immediate alias revert via `redwoodctl alias swap --alias galaxy-stable --to variant-old` and page oncall.
Marco Li: Acknowledged. I'll monitor GPU health and autoscale events during rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 50% at 09:42 PT, health checks OK.
Devon: Smoke quick report: 1) p50 latency 120ms, p95 320ms (within SLO). 2) throughput target met. 3) No error spikes. Uploading full smoke.json to the ticket.
QA Sam: Eval results: semantic 0.89, hallucination 1.3%. All good from QA.
Asha Patel: Great work — Marco proceed to 100% when ready. Please post final rollout time in thread and confirm docs PR merge afterwards. :thumbsup:
Marco Li: Rolling to 100% now. ETA ~4m.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete at 09:48 PT.
Marco Li: Done. Final check: monitoring shows stable latency and no error increase. Variant-old still pinned for 24h as backup.
Asha Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll update the catalog changelog and send a short note to #general about the new model availability. If any regression crops up tag this thread. :white_check_mark:
